lead.description: a regression fit that minimises the sum of absolute residuals and tracks a conditional median

overview_sentence: Least absolute deviations fit a line by minimising the sum of absolute residuals.

self_checks.title: Three-point line
self_checks.prompt: For the points (0,0), (1,0), and (2,3), what is the sum of absolute residuals of y=1.5x?

self_checks.title: Horizontal comparison
self_checks.prompt: For those same three points, what is the sum of absolute residuals of the line y=0?

self_checks.title: A second triple
self_checks.prompt: For (0,1), (1,1), and (2,5), which line has the smaller absolute-residual sum: y=1 or y=1+2x?
self_checks.answer: y=1+2x, with sum 2, against sum 4 for y=1.
